<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|54|THE GOSPEL|CHA. XIX.}}</noinclude>but from the beginning it vvas not so. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=9}}† And I say to you, that {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 5, 32. Mr. 10, 11. Luc. 16, 18. 1. Cor. 7, 11.''}}* Whosoeuer shal dimisse his vvife, ‖ but for fornication, and shal mary an other, doth committe aduoutrie: and he that shal mary her that is dimissed, committeth aduoutrie. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=10}}† His disciples say vnto him, If the case of a man vvith his vvife be so, it is not expedient to mary. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=11}}† Who said to them, ‖ Not al {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''χωροῦσι''. capiunt.}}∷ take this vvord, but they to vvhom it is giuen. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=12}}† For there are eunuches which vvere borne so from their mothers vvombe: and there are eunuches vvhich were made by men: and there are eunuches, vvhich haue ‖ gelded them selues for the kingdom of heauen. ‖ He that can take, let him take.⊣

{{verse|chapter=19|verse=13}}† Then {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 10, 13. Luc. 18, 15.''}}* were litle children presented to him, that he should ‖ impose hands vpon them & pray. And the disciples rebuked them. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=14}}† But {{sc|Iesvs}} said to them, Suffer the litle children, and stay them not from comming vnto me: for the kingdom of heauen is for such. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=15}}† And when he had imposed hands vpon them, he departed from thence.

{{verse|chapter=19|verse=16}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 10, 17. Luc. 18, 18.''}}* behold one came and said to him, Good Maister, vvhat good shal I doe that I may haue life euerlasting? {{verse|chapter=19|verse=17}}† Who said to him, What askest thou me of good? One is good, God. But {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ I see not (saith S. Augustine) why Christ should say, If thou wilt haue life euerlasting, keepe the commaundements: if without obseruing of thē, by only faith one might be saued. ''Aug. de Fid. & op. c. 15''.}}∷ if thou vvilt enter into life, keepe the commaundements. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=18}}† He saith to him, Which? And {{sc|Iesvs}} said, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Exo. 20, 13.''}}* ''Thou shalt not murder, Thou shalt not committe aduoutrie, Thou shalt not steale, Thou shalt not beare false vvitnes'', {{verse|chapter=19|verse=19}}† ''Honour thy father and thy mother, '' {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''* Leu. 19, 18.''}}* ''Thou shalt loue thy neighbour as thy self''. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=20}}† The yong man saith to him, Al these haue I kept from my youth: vvhat is yet vvanting vnto me? {{verse|chapter=19|verse=21}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} said to him, ‖ If thou vvilt be perfect, goe, sel the things that thou hast, & giue to the poore, and thou shalt haue treasure in heauen: and come, ‖ folovv me. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=22}}† And when the yong man had heard this vvord, he vvent avvay sad: for he had many possessions. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=23}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} said to his disciples, Amen I say to you, that a rich man shal hardely enter into the kingdom of heauen. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=24}}† And againe I say to you, it is easier for a camel to passe through the eye of a nedle, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ S. Marke expoundeth it thus, riche men trusting in their riches, ''ca. 10, 24''.}}∷ then for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heauen. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=25}}† And vvhen they had heard this, the disciples marueled very much, saying, Who then can be saued? {{verse|chapter=19|verse=26}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} beholding, said to them. With men this is impossible: but vvith God ‖ al things are possible. {{verse|chapter=19|verse=27}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō the Conuersion of S. Paul Ian. 25. And in a votiue Masse of SS. Peter and Paul, and for holy Abbotes.}}Then Peter ansvvering, said to him, Behold vve haue ‖ left al things, & haue folovved thee: ‖ vvhat therfore shal vve haue? {{verse|chapter=19|verse=28}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} said to them,<noinclude>{{rh|||Amen}}</noinclude>
